user.title: Select your Elga Ace gateway
user.description: Activate Bluetooth/service mode on the appliance and close the Remeha app. Select the gateway discovered by a local adapter or an active ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

pair.title: Name and pair your Elga Ace
pair.description: Gateway: **{address}**. Enter your appliance's Bluetooth pairing code. Leading zeroes are preserved. Keep Bluetooth/service mode active and close other apps connected to the gateway. All entities are read-only.

data_description.name: Used as the device name and entity name prefix.
data_description.pin: Your appliance's numeric Bluetooth passkey, up to six digits. The code is never exposed as an entity or included in diagnostics.

progress.connecting: Pairing with the supplied code, unlocking BLE services, authorizing CAN and the appliance, then verifying an authenticated register read...

error.invalid_name: Enter a device name between 1 and 80 characters.
error.invalid_pin: Enter a numeric Bluetooth passkey containing one to six digits.
error.invalid_auth: Bluetooth rejected the pairing code. Check the code on the appliance. After an incorrect code the gateway may need about a minute before another attempt.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Activate Bluetooth/service mode, check the adapter or proxy is within range with a free active connection slot, and close the Remeha app and standalone reader.
error.cannot_read: Connected, but an authenticated register could not be read. Check that this is an Elga Ace EHC-07 gateway and try again.
error.handshake_failed: The gateway did not accept the BLE/CAN/appliance handshake. Keep service mode active and check the Home Assistant logs.
error.proxy_pairing_required: Install the supplied elga-pairing-package.yaml and companion component on the selected ESPHome proxy, enable native API encryption, flash it and reconnect it to Home Assistant. Stock proxy firmware does not forward the pairing code. See esphome/README.md.
error.unsupported_adapter: This Bluetooth transport cannot pair with a passkey. Use local Linux/BlueZ or an ESP32 ESPHome proxy with current firmware and the supplied pairing helper.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth gateway is already configured.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured connectable GTW/EHC gateways were found. Enable Bluetooth/service mode, check your local adapter or active ESPHome proxy and start setup again.
abort.not_supported: This is not a supported connectable GTW/EHC gateway.
abort.reauth_successful: The pairing code was updated. The integration is reconnecting.

init.title: Elga Ace polling and device name
init.description: Core measurements refresh every polling interval. Other registers rotate in bounded batches. All catalog entities stay available in the entity registry; unsupported registers remain unavailable.

data.name: Device name
data.slow_batch_size: Maximum background register reads per cycle

data_description.scan_interval: 20-300 seconds. Default: 30. Each cycle has a 15-second read budget.
data_description.slow_batch_size: 1-60. Default: 20. Initial population of the full catalog takes several minutes. Parameters are refreshed at most once every ten minutes.

error.invalid_name: Enter a device name between 1 and 80 characters.
